name: ABL Scoreboard
author: StevenFay
description: Live, recent and upcoming Australian Baseball League games, from the MLB Stats API, on ChuckBuilds' baseball scoreboard layouts.

versions.notes: First release, adapted from ChuckBuilds' baseball-scoreboard 1.66.0 (ledmatrix-plugins d43e302). Its minor-league path (MLB Stats API) reads the ABL instead: sport 17, league 595, in Australian dates, all season (November-February), refreshed every 30 minutes, with team logos from MLB's image server and seven-inning games read as complete. MLB and NCAA Baseball are switched off.
